experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Migrated a patient-portal front end from server-rendered pages to React and TypeScript, one route at a time behind feature flags.
Built Node.js and Express REST APIs backed by PostgreSQL for appointment and billing flows.
Added Sentry error tracking with a redaction layer so health data never left the service.
Cut median page load on the busiest route by roughly a third by caching reference data in Redis.

experience.title: Associate Software Engineer

Made order-event consumers idempotent and added a dead-letter queue after a duplicate-charge incident.
Wrote integration tests with Testcontainers and ran them in a GitHub Actions pipeline.
